listenings.text: Hi, this is Tyler again. People always ask me what I like. So, here it is. I like basketball, of course, but I don't like running. I like watching movies at night, and my favorite kind is comedy. I don't like horror movies. They are not fun for me. I like video games too. My favorite game is a football game. And I want to learn a second language. I want to go to Brazil one day, so I want to learn Portuguese. What about you?

Good afternoon, everybody. Today we finish early, so you have a free afternoon. Here are your options. Option one: the swimming pool, open from two to five. Option two: the game room, with video games and a big screen. Option three: a movie in the main hall. Today the movie is about a young basketball team, and it starts at three. If you want to go to the city, you need an adult with you. Please tell me your choice before two o'clock. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Bruno finishes practice at one o'clock. He reads the three options for the afternoon. He talks to a friend about the movie. He chooses the movie about the basketball team. He tells the coach his choice.
